text: is there any way to, say i have 4 legs on a table, and i wand all 4 sides of the leg to be the same thing, so am i able to merge them all into one uv to map rather than 8 of them i mean 16* of them
resolution: Repeated table-leg faces can now share one authored UV footprint without merging mesh topology. Shift-select all 16 repeated UV islands, keep the intended footprint active, then use UV canvas right-click → Arrange Selected Islands → Stack on Active Island. Every selected face maps into the active bounds and samples the same texture pixels; the operation participates in UV undo/redo.
